title: The Wetland That Protected a City
short_teaser: Wetlands absorb water, slow flooding, filter pollutants, and provide habitat.
story: Wetlands absorb water, slow flooding, filter pollutants, and provide habitat. When they are removed, communities may lose a natural system that had been doing valuable work quietly. What looks unused may be performing essential functions. Nature and place can teach timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of seeing familiar surroundings with fresh attention. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: What looks unused may be performing essential functions. Nature and place can teach timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of seeing familiar surroundings with fresh attention.
spark_application: Notice one natural pattern, place, or seasonal change today. Write one sentence about what it suggests about your own pace or direction. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
